channel.title: AdvisoryOps Community Feed
channel.description: Top-scored healthcare cybersecurity and device-safety advisories

item.title: CVE-2018-0171
item.description: Cisco IOS and IOS XE software has a critical vulnerability in the Smart Install feature that could allow an attacker to remotely crash the device or run harmful code. A patch is available, so it is essential to update your software immediately to protect your network from potential attacks. Please prioritize this action to prevent any service disruptions.

item.title: CVE-2023-20273
item.description: Cisco IOS XE Software has a critical vulnerability in its web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute commands with root access. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is recommended to update your software immediately to prevent potential unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2023-46805
item.description: Ivanti's ICS and Policy Secure products have a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers to access restricted areas without proper authentication. A fix is available, so it's important to apply the patch immediately to protect sensitive resources. Make sure to update your systems to mitigate this risk.

item.title: CVE-2024-21887
item.description: Ivanti Connect Secure and Ivanti Policy Secure have a critical command injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated administrator to execute unauthorized commands. A patch is available to fix this issue. It's recommended to update your systems immediately to protect against potential threats.

item.title: Cisco IOS XE Software Web UI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (CVE-2023-20198)
item.description: Cisco IOS XE Software has a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to gain unauthorized access and escalate their privileges. A patch is available, so it's important to update your systems immediately to protect against potential exploitation. Ensure that your devices are checked and updated to prevent unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2023-48788
item.description: Fortinet FortiClientEMS versions 7.2.0 to 7.2.2 and 7.0.1 to 7.0.10 have a critical security vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute unauthorized commands. A patch is available, so it is essential to update to the latest version immediately to protect your systems. Please prioritize this update to ensure the safety of our network.

item.title: CVE-2024-1709
item.description: ConnectWise ScreenConnect versions 23.9.7 and earlier have a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to bypass authentication and access sensitive information or systems. A patch is available to resolve this issue. It is recommended to update to the latest version as soon as possible to protect your systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-9082
item.description: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API. | Drupal Core

item.title: CVE-2025-4427
item.description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile has a critical authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to protected resources through its API. A patch is available to fix this issue. It's essential to update your software immediately to prevent potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-4428
item.description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile versions 12.5.0.0 and earlier have a critical vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code through specially crafted requests. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is essential to update your systems to avoid potential exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2025-57819
item.description: Sangoma's FreePBX has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to its administrator interface, potentially leading to remote control of the system. Patches are available for versions 15.0.66, 16.0.89, and 17.0.3. It is urgent to update your FreePBX to the latest version to protect against this security risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-6554
item.description: Google Chrome versions before 138.0.7204.96 have a high-severity vulnerability that lets attackers read or write data remotely through a specially crafted webpage. A patch is available for this issue. It's important to upgrade to the latest version of Chrome to protect against this risk.

item.title: CVE-2013-3893
item.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer versions 6 through 11 have a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to run harmful code on your system through malicious JavaScript. A patch is available, so it's essential to update your Internet Explorer immediately to protect your network. This will help prevent potential security risks from remote attackers.

item.title: CVE-2013-3918
item.description: Microsoft Windows contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the InformationCardSigninHelper Class ActiveX control, icardie.dll. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted webpage. When a user views the webpage, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. item.title: CVE-2010-3962
item.description: Microsoft Internet Explorer versions 6, 7, and 8 have a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers to run unauthorized code through specific web content features. There is no patch available for this issue, so it is important to avoid using these outdated versions of Internet Explorer. Ensure that users switch to a more secure browser to protect hospital systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-60137
item.description: WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations. | WordPress Core

item.title: CVE-2026-63030
item.description: WordPress 6.9.x before 6.9.5 and 7.0.x before 7.0.2 is affected by a REST API batch endpoint route confusion issue which, combined with the author__not_in WP_Query SQL Injection (CVE-2026-60137), could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-35273
item.description: Vulnerability in the PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools product of Oracle PeopleSoft (component: Updates Environment Management). Supported versions that are affected are 8.61 and 8.62. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools. item.title: CVE-2016-5195
item.description: A critical vulnerability exists in the Linux kernel that can allow local users to gain unauthorized access to system privileges. This weakness has been exploited in the past and does have a patch available. It is highly recommended that you update your Linux systems to the latest version to protect against potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2024-36401
item.description: GeoServer has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary code, affecting all versions before 2.22.6, 2.23.6, 2.24.4, and 2.25.2. Patches are available for these versions, and it's recommended to upgrade immediately or, as a temporary measure, remove the gt-complex module, which may affect functionality. Ensure all instances of GeoServer are secured to prevent potential exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2025-20352
item.description: Cisco IOS and IOS XE software have a critical vulnerability in their Simple Network Management Protocol that could allow low-privileged attackers to cause a service outage, or high-privileged attackers to gain complete control of the device. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is crucial to apply the patch immediately to protect your systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-7775
item.description: Citrix has identified a critical memory overflow vulnerability in the NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway products, which can allow hackers to execute remote code or cause service interruptions. A patch is available, and it's crucial to apply it immediately to protect your systems. Ensure that all configurations, especially involving IPv6, are reviewed as part of this update.

item.title: CVE-2007-0671
item.description: Microsoft Excel has a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers to run harmful code. A patch is currently unavailable, so it’s essential to limit the use of affected versions of Excel in your environment. Regularly review your systems to ensure that they are not exposed to this risk.

item.title: CVE-2017-1000353
item.description: Jenkins software versions 2.56 and earlier, as well as 2.46.1 LTS and earlier, have a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code without authentication. A patch is available, so it's important to upgrade to Jenkins version 2.46.2 LTS or newer immediately to secure your systems. Be sure to check your systems for these versions and apply the update as soon as possible.

item.title: CVE-2024-8069
item.description: Citrix Session Recording has a critical vulnerability that allows an authenticated user on the same network to execute harmful commands with high-level access. A patch is available to fix this issue. It's essential to apply the patch immediately to safeguard your systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-20281
item.description: Cisco has identified a critical vulnerability in their ISE and ISE-PIC products that could allow an unverified attacker to gain full control of the device remotely without needing any login credentials. A patch is available, so it is crucial to update these systems immediately to prevent potential exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2025-20333
item.description: Cisco has identified a critical vulnerability in the VPN web server of its Secure Firewall products that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute harmful code on the device. A patch is available, and it is strongly recommended that you apply it immediately to protect your systems from potential breaches. Please ensure all VPN users are updated and informed about this security risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-20337
item.description: Cisco has identified a critical vulnerability in their Identity Services Engine (ISE) that allows attackers to run harmful code without needing any credentials. A patch is available, and it's crucial to apply it immediately to protect against potential unauthorized access to your systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-20362
item.description: Cisco has identified a critical vulnerability in the VPN web server of Cisco Secure ASA and FTD software that could allow unauthorized access to restricted areas, potentially causing devices to crash. A patch is available, and it is strongly recommended that you upgrade to the latest software version to protect your network. Please prioritize this update to prevent any disruption in service.

item.title: CVE-2025-24016
item.description: Wazuh, a threat management tool, has a critical security vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This affects versions 4.4.0 to 4.9.0, but version 4.9.1 includes a patch to fix the issue. It is essential to upgrade to version 4.9.1 immediately to protect against potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-32433
item.description: Erlang/OTP has a critical vulnerability in its SSH server that allows attackers to execute commands without authentication. Patches are available for the most recent versions, so it's essential to update to OTP-27.3.3, OTP-26.2.5.11, or OTP-25.3.2.20 as soon as possible. If you can't patch immediately, consider disabling the SSH server or adjusting firewall rules to limit access.

item.title: CVE-2025-3935
item.description: ConnectWise ScreenConnect versions 25.2.3 and earlier have a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code remotely if specific system keys are compromised. A patch is available in version 2025.4, which disables the vulnerable feature. It's recommended to upgrade to this version immediately to protect against this risk.

item.title: CVE-2025-49704
item.description: Microsoft Office SharePoint has a critical vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to run malicious code over the network. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is recommended to apply the patch immediately to protect hospital systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-49706
item.description: Microsoft Office SharePoint has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized access, potentially letting attackers spoof identities on the network. A patch is available to fix this issue. We recommend updating SharePoint immediately to enhance security.

item.title: CVE-2025-5086
item.description: Dassault Systèmes has identified a serious vulnerability in their DELMIA Apriso software that could allow remote code execution. This is considered a critical risk, and a patch is available. To protect your systems, it is crucial to apply the patch as soon as possible.

item.title: CVE-2025-53690
item.description: Sitecore's Experience Manager and Experience Platform have a critical vulnerability that allows code injection through untrusted data. A patch is available, so it's essential to update these systems to mitigate potential security risks. Ensure that all installations are updated to the latest version as soon as possible.

item.title: CVE-2016-7836
item.description: SKYSEA Client View software versions 11.221.03 and earlier have a critical vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the system. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is recommended to update your software immediately to protect your network.

item.title: CVE-2025-59287
item.description: Microsoft Windows Server Update Service has a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute harmful code remotely. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is crucial to apply the patch immediately to protect your network from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-24893
item.description: XWiki has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized users to execute harmful commands, affecting the entire system's security. A patch is available in versions 15.10.11, 16.4.1, and 16.5.0RC1. It is recommended to upgrade to these versions immediately to protect your systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-48703
item.description: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known. | CWP Control Web Panel

item.title: CVE-2025-55182
item.description: Meta's React Server Components have a critical vulnerability that allows unauthorized remote code execution in specific versions 19.0.0 to 19.2.0. There is no current patch available to fix this issue. It is recommended to immediately assess your systems for these versions and either upgrade to a secure version or disable the affected components until a remedy is found.

item.title: CVE-2025-66478
item.description: The advisory from Meta indicates that the reported vulnerability in Next.js is a duplicate and does not require further action. No new risks or patches are being introduced from this advisory. Please continue monitoring for other relevant security updates.

item.title: CVE-2008-0015
item.description: Microsoft has identified a critical vulnerability in the Active Template Library that affects multiple versions of Windows, allowing remote attackers to execute unauthorized code. A patch is not available for this issue, so it's crucial to limit exposure by disabling the affected ActiveX control if it is not essential for operations. Further steps should be taken to monitor and protect affected systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2009-0238
item.description: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object. | Microsoft Office

item.title: CVE-2012-1854
item.description: Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) contains an insecure library loading vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution. | Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)

item.title: CVE-2023-21529
item.description: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution. | Microsoft Exchange Server

item.title: CVE-2024-37079
item.description: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution. | Broadcom VMware vCenter Server

item.title: CVE-2025-37164
item.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise has identified a critical remote code execution vulnerability in HPE OneView, and a patch is available. It's crucial for security teams to quickly apply this update to protect hospital networks from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-40551
item.description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution, which would allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine. This could be exploited without authentication. | SolarWinds Web Help Desk

item.title: CVE-2025-49113
item.description: Roundcube Webmail has a critical vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute malicious code remotely. A patch is available in version 1.5.10 and later, and 1.6.11 or newer. It's important to update to a secure version immediately to protect against this risk.
